india_gate.name: India Gate & Kartavya Path
india_gate.description: An iconic 42-meter-tall triumphal arch memorial dedicated to 84,000 soldiers of the British Indian Army, surrounded by lush lawns, boating canals, and the eternal flame.
india_gate.best_time_to_visit: Evening (06:00 PM - 09:00 PM) for illuminated night view and cool breezes.

qutub_minar.name: Qutub Minar & Complex
qutub_minar.description: A 72.5-meter soaring UNESCO World Heritage minaret built in 1192, featuring intricate red sandstone carvings, the famous 1600-year-old rust-resistant Iron Pillar, and Alai Darwaza.
qutub_minar.best_time_to_visit: Morning or late afternoon (October to March).

red_fort.name: Red Fort (Lal Qila)
red_fort.description: The grand 17th-century Mughal palace fort built by Emperor Shah Jahan. Home to Diwan-i-Aam, Diwan-i-Khas, Lahori Gate, and the annual Independence Day Prime Ministerial address.
red_fort.best_time_to_visit: Morning (09:30 AM - 12:00 PM), Tuesday to Sunday.

lotus_temple.name: Lotus Temple (Bahá'í House of Worship)
lotus_temple.description: A breathtaking flowerlike white marble sanctuary with 27 free-standing petals, open to people of all faiths for silent meditation and prayer amidst 26 acres of manicured ponds.
lotus_temple.best_time_to_visit: Afternoon to Sunset (03:00 PM - 05:00 PM), Tuesday to Sunday.

akshardham_temple.name: Swaminarayan Akshardham Temple
akshardham_temple.description: A sprawling spiritual campus showcasing 10,000 years of Indian culture, exquisite Rajasthani pink sandstone carvings, Sahaj Anand water laser show, and cultural boat ride.
akshardham_temple.best_time_to_visit: Afternoon through Evening (stay for the musical water show at 07:15 PM).

humayuns_tomb.name: Humayun's Tomb
humayuns_tomb.description: A UNESCO World Heritage Mughal garden-tomb built in 1570 by Empress Bega Begum, representing the architectural inspiration behind the Taj Mahal with Charbagh geometric gardens.
humayuns_tomb.best_time_to_visit: Early morning sunrise or golden hour afternoon.

dilli_haat_ina.name: Dilli Haat (INA)
dilli_haat_ina.description: An open-air rural craft bazaar and authentic food court run by DTTDC, offering artisanal handlooms, regional cuisines from all 28 Indian states, and live folk performances.
dilli_haat_ina.best_time_to_visit: Evening (05:00 PM - 09:30 PM) for lively dining and handicrafts shopping.

bangla_sahib.name: Gurudwara Bangla Sahib
bangla_sahib.description: One of the most prominent Sikh gurdwaras in India, associated with the eighth Sikh Guru, Guru Har Krishan. Renowned for its golden dome, holy Sarovar pond, and 24/7 free community kitchen (Langar).
bangla_sahib.best_time_to_visit: Open 24 hours. Early morning and dusk during the holy Sarovar illumination.

iskcon_temple_delhi.name: Sri Sri Radha Parthasarathi Mandir (ISKCON Delhi)
iskcon_temple_delhi.description: A majestic temple complex dedicated to Lord Krishna and Radharani atop Hare Krishna Hills, featuring Vedic animatronics museum, Art Gallery, and Govinda's vegetarian restaurant.
iskcon_temple_delhi.best_time_to_visit: Evening Aarti (07:00 PM) or early morning Mangala Aarti.

chhatarpur_temple.name: Shri Aadya Katyayani Shaktipith (Chhatarpur Temple)
chhatarpur_temple.description: Spread over 70 acres in South Delhi, this is the second-largest temple complex in India, completely carved from pure white marble and dedicated to Goddess Katyayani.
chhatarpur_temple.best_time_to_visit: Morning or evening hours, especially during Navratri festivals.

birla_mandir.name: Laxminarayan Temple (Birla Mandir)
birla_mandir.description: Inaugurated by Mahatma Gandhi in 1939 with the condition that all castes be allowed entry, this Orissan-style temple honors Lord Vishnu and Goddess Lakshmi with cascades and fountains.

jhandewalan_temple.name: Jhandewalan Mata Mandir
jhandewalan_temple.description: An ancient shrine dedicated to Maa Aadi Shakti, named after the prayer flags (jhandas) hoisted on its shikhara, drawing millions of devotees during Navratri.
jhandewalan_temple.best_time_to_visit: Morning Aarti (06:00 AM) or evening (07:30 PM).

sarojini_nagar_market.name: Sarojini Nagar Market
sarojini_nagar_market.description: Delhi's undisputed fashion epicenter, famous for designer export surplus apparel, shoes, bags, and street accessories at unbelievable bargain prices.
sarojini_nagar_market.best_time_to_visit: Weekdays (Tuesday to Friday, 11:00 AM - 04:00 PM) to avoid weekend rush.

lajpat_nagar_market.name: Lajpat Nagar Central Market
lajpat_nagar_market.description: A premier hub for Indian ethnic wear, bridal lehengas, authentic Lucknowi chikan embroidery, mehendi artists, and mouthwatering Ram Ladoo street snacks.
lajpat_nagar_market.best_time_to_visit: Midday (12:00 PM - 06:00 PM), Tuesday to Sunday.

khan_market.name: Khan Market
khan_market.description: One of the world's most prestigious retail streets, established in 1951. Famed for upscale designer boutiques, heritage bookstores (Faqir Chand), and artisanal European bakeries.
khan_market.best_time_to_visit: Late afternoon to dinner hours (04:00 PM - 10:00 PM).

janpath_market.name: Janpath Market & Tibetan Market
janpath_market.description: A colorful shopping avenue running off Connaught Place, popular for brass artifacts, ethnic jewelry, boho scarves, Pashmina shawls, and Tibetan thangkas.
janpath_market.best_time_to_visit: Afternoon (01:00 PM - 06:00 PM), Monday to Saturday.

karol_bagh_market.name: Karol Bagh Market (Ajmal Khan Road)
karol_bagh_market.description: A bustling multi-specialty shopping district combining Bank Street's famed gold jewellery bazaars, Ghaffar electronics market, and grand wedding apparel stores.

majnu_ka_tilla.name: Majnu Ka Tilla (Little Tibet)
majnu_ka_tilla.description: A vibrant Tibetan refugee settlement along the Yamuna featuring a colorful Buddhist monastery, authentic Himalayan cafes serving laphing and thukpa, and Korean fashion boutiques.
majnu_ka_tilla.best_time_to_visit: Afternoon to evening (02:00 PM - 08:00 PM) for food and culture.

nehru_planetarium.name: Nehru Planetarium (Tara Mandal)
nehru_planetarium.description: Set within the lush Teen Murti Estate, this premier astronomy center features a full-dome digital sky theater projecting mesmerizing space simulations and stargazing telescopes.
nehru_planetarium.best_time_to_visit: Check sky theater show timings (English & Hindi shows daily).

museum_of_illusions.name: Museum of Illusions (Connaught Place)
museum_of_illusions.description: An interactive edutainment attraction featuring 50+ optical illusions, anti-gravity rooms, vortex tunnels, and holographic trick installations in central Connaught Place.
museum_of_illusions.best_time_to_visit: Afternoon (book slots in advance on weekends).

kalkaji_temple.name: Kalkaji Temple
kalkaji_temple.description: Highly revered ancient Shakti temple in South Delhi dedicated to Goddess Kali, drawing thousands of devotees during Navratri.

jama_masjid.name: Jama Masjid
jama_masjid.description: One of India's largest and most historic imperial mosques, built by Mughal Emperor Shah Jahan between 1644 and 1656.

chawri_bazar.name: Chawri Bazar
chawri_bazar.description: Historic 1840s wholesale market in Old Delhi renowned for brass, copper artifacts, and ornate paper wedding invitations.

amrit_udyan.name: Amrit Udyan
amrit_udyan.description: Picturesque sprawling presidential gardens at Rashtrapati Bhavan, renowned for rare tulips, seasonal blossoms, and terraced fountains.

indira_gandhi_national_center_of_arts.name: Indira Gandhi National Center Of Arts

parliamanet_house.name: Parliamanet House
parliamanet_house.description: Historic political seat comprising the heritage circular Samvidhan Sadan and the modern triangular Parliament House.

hazrat_nizamuddin_aulia_dargah.name: Hazrat Nizamuddin Aulia Dargah
hazrat_nizamuddin_aulia_dargah.description: Sacred 14th-century Sufi shrine of Saint Hazrat Nizamuddin Auliya, renowned for spiritual qawwali evenings and historic marble courtyards.

purana_quila.name: Purana Quila
purana_quila.description: Ancient 16th-century fortress built under Sher Shah Suri and Humayun, traditionally identified with ancient Indraprastha.

national_zoological_park.name: National Zoological Park
national_zoological_park.description: Expansive 176-acre zoo located next to Purana Qila, housing white tigers, Asiatic lions, and diverse avifauna.

pragati_maidan.name: Pragati Maidan
pragati_maidan.description: India's premier international exhibition center featuring Bharat Mandapam, hosting global summits and trade expos.

bhalaswa_lake.name: Bhalaswa Lake
bhalaswa_lake.description: Horseshoe oxbow lake in North Delhi, originally created by the Yamuna River, featuring boating facilities and seasonal wetland birds.

deer_park.name: Deer Park
deer_park.description: Charming public park near Hauz Khas known as the 'lungs of Delhi', featuring a deer enclosure, duck pond, and walking tracks.

hauz_khas_fort.name: Hauz Khas Fort
hauz_khas_fort.description: 13th-century medieval reservoir, madrasa, and pavilions built by Alauddin Khalji, juxtaposed beside an upscale bohemian arts and café hub.

railway_museum.name: Railway Museum
railway_museum.description: Historic museum in Chanakyapuri showcasing the 170-year legacy of Indian Railways with outdoor steam locomotives and vintage royal coaches.

malai_mandir.name: Malai Mandir
malai_mandir.description: Prominent hilltop South Indian Dravidian-style Hindu temple in RK Puram dedicated to Lord Murugan (Swaminatha Swami).

sanjay_van.name: Sanjay Van
sanjay_van.description: Sprawling 783-acre city forest in South Delhi near Vasant Kunj, offering serene wooded trails, ancient ruins, and birdwatching.

mehrauli_archaeological_park.name: Mehrauli Archaeological Park
mehrauli_archaeological_park.description: Sprawling 200-acre park adjoining Qutub Minar preserving over 100 historical monuments spanning 1,000 years, including Balban's Tomb.

st_james_church.name: St. James Church
st_james_church.description: Oldest surviving Christian church in Delhi, consecrated in 1836 at Kashmere Gate with classical Renaissance neoclassical architecture.

veer_bhumi.name: Veer Bhumi
veer_bhumi.description: Memorial dedicated to Prime Minister Rajiv Gandhi near Raj Ghat, encircled by 54 carved red sandstone lotuses.

gurudwara_sis_ganj.name: Gurudwara Sis Ganj
gurudwara_sis_ganj.description: Sacred historic Sikh shrine in Chandni Chowk commemorating the 1675 martyrdom of the ninth Sikh Guru, Guru Tegh Bahadur.

chandni_chowk.name: Chandni Chowk
chandni_chowk.description: 17th-century historic marketplace in Old Delhi designed by Mughal Princess Jahanara, famous for street food, jewelry, and spices.

lodhi_garden.name: Lodhi Garden
lodhi_garden.description: Serene 90-acre landscaped park containing 15th-century architectural tombs of Mohammed Shah and Sikandar Lodi.

jantar_mantar.name: Jantar Mantar
jantar_mantar.description: UNESCO World Heritage equinoctial astronomical observatory built in 1724 by Maharaja Jai Singh II of Jaipur.

delhi_metro_museum_sansad_marg.name: Delhi Metro Museum (sansad Marg)
delhi_metro_museum_sansad_marg.description: South Asia's first metro museum, situated at Patel Chowk Metro Station, tracing the engineering milestones of Delhi Metro.

kalkaji_mandir.name: Kalkaji Mandir
kalkaji_mandir.description: Highly revered ancient Shakti temple in South Delhi dedicated to Goddess Kali, drawing thousands of devotees during Navratri.

tughlakabad_fort.name: Tughlakabad Fort
tughlakabad_fort.description: Monumental 14th-century stone fortress built by Ghiyasuddin Tughlaq with massive sloping stone walls and bastions.

surajkund.name: Surajkund
surajkund.description: Ancient 10th-century semicircular sun reservoir built by King Suraj Pal, host of the famous annual International Crafts Mela.

suraj_kund.name: Suraj Kund
suraj_kund.description: Ancient 10th-century semicircular sun reservoir built by King Suraj Pal, host of the famous annual International Crafts Mela.

haus_khas_village.name: Haus Khas Village
haus_khas_village.description: Chic urban village adjoining the historic 13th-century reservoir, renowned for boutique fashion, independent art studios, and rooftop dining.

hauz_khas_village.name: Hauz Khas Village
hauz_khas_village.description: Chic urban village adjoining the historic 13th-century reservoir, renowned for boutique fashion, independent art studios, and rooftop dining.

agrasen_ki_baoli.name: Agrasen Ki Baoli
agrasen_ki_baoli.description: Historic 108-step 14th-century stepwell near Connaught Place featuring 3 levels of arched niches and intricate stonework.

agrasen_baoli.name: Agrasen Baoli
agrasen_baoli.description: Historic 108-step 14th-century stepwell near Connaught Place featuring 3 levels of arched niches and intricate stonework.

rashtrapati_bhawan.name: Rashtrapati Bhawan
rashtrapati_bhawan.description: Official 330-acre residence of the President of India, designed by Sir Edwin Lutyens featuring 340 rooms and grand classical colonnades.

national_museum.name: National Museum
national_museum.description: Premier national museum on Janpath housing 200,000+ treasures spanning 5,000 years from the Indus Valley Civilization to modern art.

museo_camera_center_for_the_photogrphic_.name: Museo Camera Center For The Photogrphic Arts

garden_of_five_senses.name: Garden Of Five Senses
garden_of_five_senses.description: 20-acre experiential public park in Said-ul-Ajaib designed around natural rock formations, musical fountains, and sensory flora.

dilli_haat_pitampura.name: Dilli Haat Pitampura
dilli_haat_pitampura.description: Open-air crafts bazaar and food plaza in North Delhi showcasing handlooms and ethnic regional cuisines.

dr_ambedkar_national_memorial.name: Dr. Ambedkar National Memorial
dr_ambedkar_national_memorial.description: Architectural memorial at 26 Alipur Road designed like an open Constitution book, honouring Dr. B.R. Ambedkar.

science_museum.name: Science Museum
science_museum.description: National Science Centre near Pragati Maidan featuring eight levels of hands-on interactive physics, biology, and robotics galleries.

craft_museum.name: Craft Museum
craft_museum.description: Vibrant cultural museum at Pragati Maidan celebrating India's rich tribal handicrafts, textiles, and traditional village dwellings.

bharat_mandapam.name: Bharat Mandapam
bharat_mandapam.description: State-of-the-art international exhibition and convention centre at Pragati Maidan, venue of the historic 2023 G20 summit.

connaught_place_market.name: Connaught Place Market
connaught_place_market.description: Iconic Georgian-style colonnaded commercial and cultural hub of Delhi, built in 1933 with concentric circular avenues and dining.

baba_baghel_singh_sikh_heritage_multimed.name: Baba Baghel Singh Sikh Heritage Multimedia Museum

shri_digambar_jain_lal_mandir.name: Shri Digambar Jain Lal Mandir
shri_digambar_jain_lal_mandir.description: Oldest Digambar Jain temple in Delhi, situated opposite Red Fort, renowned for its red sandstone shikharas and avian charity hospital.

digamber_jain_lal_mandir.name: Digamber Jain Lal Mandir
digamber_jain_lal_mandir.description: Oldest Digambar Jain temple in Delhi, situated opposite Red Fort, renowned for its red sandstone shikharas and avian charity hospital.

gurudwara_sis_ganj_sahib.name: Gurudwara Sis Ganj Sahib
gurudwara_sis_ganj_sahib.description: Sacred historic Sikh shrine in Chandni Chowk commemorating the 1675 martyrdom of the ninth Sikh Guru, Guru Tegh Bahadur.

sulabh_international_museum_of_toilets.name: Sulabh International Museum Of Toilets
sulabh_international_museum_of_toilets.description: Unique global sanitation museum in Mahavir Enclave exploring the 4,500-year evolution of sanitation technology and hygiene.

rashtriya_dalit_prerna_sthal_and_green_g.name: Rashtriya Dalit Prerna Sthal And Green Garden

national_rail_museum.name: National Rail Museum
national_rail_museum.description: Historic museum in Chanakyapuri showcasing the 170-year legacy of Indian Railways with outdoor steam locomotives and vintage royal coaches.

chandni_chowk_market.name: Chandni Chowk Market
chandni_chowk_market.description: 17th-century historic marketplace in Old Delhi designed by Mughal Princess Jahanara, famous for street food, jewelry, and spices.

rajghat.name: Rajghat
rajghat.description: Serene black marble memorial dedicated to Mahatma Gandhi situated amid peaceful manicured lawns by the Yamuna River.

aravali_bio_diversity_park.name: Aravali Bio-diversity Park
aravali_bio_diversity_park.description: 692-acre ecological conservation park in Vasant Kunj restoring native forest communities and birdlife of the ancient Aravalli range.

buddha_jayanti_park.name: Buddha Jayanti Park
buddha_jayanti_park.description: Sprawling landscaped park on the Delhi Ridge commemorating the 2500th anniversary of Gautama Buddha's enlightenment.

tughlaqabad_fort.name: Tughlaqabad Fort
tughlaqabad_fort.description: Monumental 14th-century stone fortress built by Ghiyasuddin Tughlaq with massive sloping stone walls and bastions.

national_handicrafts_and_handlooms_museu.name: National Handicrafts And Handlooms Museum
national_handicrafts_and_handlooms_museu.description: Vibrant cultural museum at Pragati Maidan celebrating India's rich tribal handicrafts, textiles, and traditional village dwellings.

central_park.name: Central Park
central_park.description: Vibrant manicured public park in the inner circle of Connaught Place, featuring musical fountains and an iconic 207-foot monumental national flag.

gurudwara_bangla_sahib_baba_kharag_singh.name: Gurudwara Bangla Sahib (baba Kharag Singh Marg, Connaught Place)

pracheen_hanuman_mandir_baba_kharag_sing.name: Pracheen Hanuman Mandir (baba Kharag Singh Marg , Connaught Place)

saat_manjila_shri_sanatan_dharam_mandir_.name: Saat Manjila Shri Sanatan Dharam Mandir, Tilak Nagar

aravalli_biodiversity_park.name: Aravalli Biodiversity Park
aravalli_biodiversity_park.description: 692-acre ecological conservation park in Vasant Kunj restoring native forest communities and birdlife of the ancient Aravalli range.

kisan_ghat.name: Kisan Ghat
kisan_ghat.description: Memorial dedicated to Chaudhary Charan Singh, the fifth Prime Minister of India and champion of farmer welfare.

shakti_sthal.name: Shakti Sthal
shakti_sthal.description: Memorial on the banks of Yamuna dedicated to Prime Minister Indira Gandhi, marked by a massive monolith of iron ore.

vijay_ghat.name: Vijay Ghat
vijay_ghat.description: Memorial dedicated to India's second Prime Minister, Lal Bahadur Shastri, who coined the slogan 'Jai Jawan Jai Kisan'.

the_deer_park.name: The Deer Park
the_deer_park.description: Charming public park near Hauz Khas known as the 'lungs of Delhi', featuring a deer enclosure, duck pond, and walking tracks.

tomb_of_sultan_firoz_shah_tughlaq.name: Tomb Of Sultan Firoz Shah Tughlaq

ceiling_of_the_tomb_of_sultan_firoz_shah.name: Ceiling Of The Tomb Of Sultan Firoz Shah Tughlaq

national_gallery_of_modern_art.name: National Gallery Of Modern Art
national_gallery_of_modern_art.description: Premier modern art gallery housed in historic Jaipur House near India Gate, displaying masterpieces by Raja Ravi Varma and Amrita Sher-Gil.

safdarjungs_tomb.name: Safdarjungs Tomb
safdarjungs_tomb.description: The last grand garden-tomb of Mughal architecture in Delhi, built in 1754 for Safdarjung with domed marble and red sandstone.

indira_gandhi_memorial_museum.name: Indira Gandhi Memorial Museum
indira_gandhi_memorial_museum.description: Memorial museum at 1 Safdarjung Road, preserving the former residence, photographs, and personal effects of Prime Minister Indira Gandhi.

nehru_memorial_museum_and_library.name: Nehru Memorial Museum And Library
nehru_memorial_museum_and_library.description: Historic Teen Murti Bhavan complex and Pradhanmantri Sangrahalaya dedicated to India's freedom struggle and prime ministers.

shantivan.name: Shantivan
shantivan.description: Solemn memorial of independent India's first Prime Minister, Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru, set amid lush peaceful lawns.

coronation_park.name: Coronation Park & Memorial
coronation_park.description: Historic vast park at Burari Road where the grand Delhi Durbars of 1877, 1903, and 1911 were held, featuring the tall sandstone Coronation Memorial obelisk.
coronation_park.best_time_to_visit: October to March, early morning or late afternoon for leisurely historic walks.
